briefing.purpose: Dynamic-Type system serif for the main live briefing sentence only.

section-title.purpose: Bold system-sans titles for major briefing groups.

headline.purpose: System-sans leads, actions, and privacy promises.

body.purpose: System-sans previews, explanations, controls, and provenance.

caption.purpose: Compact system-sans time, counts, and identity labels.

components.name: Attention Action
components.description: The single inverted next-step surface for the first convo that needs attention.
components.css: .ds-attention-action { color-scheme: light dark; width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); color: light-dark(#ffffff, #000000); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; text-align: left; } .ds-attention-action:hover { cursor: pointer; } .ds-attention-action:focus-visible { outline: auto; } .ds-attention-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; flex: 0 0 44px; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; background: light-dark(#333333, #f5f5f5); } .ds-attention-icon svg { width: 1em; height: 1em; } .ds-attention-copy { display: grid; gap: 2px; } .ds-attention-copy strong { font-weight: 600; } .ds-attention-copy span { opacity: 0.72; }

components.name: Update Row
components.description: A flat, source-attributed conversation update with a circular identity and non-color attention value.
components.css: .ds-update-row { color-scheme: light dark; width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px; padding: 16px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid light-dark(#ebebeb, #333333); background: light-dark(#ffffff, #000000); color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; text-align: left; } .ds-update-row:hover { cursor: pointer; } .ds-update-row:focus-visible { outline: auto; } .ds-update-avatar { display: grid; place-items: center; flex: 0 0 44px; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; background: light-dark(#f5f5f5, #1c1c1c); font-weight: 600; } .ds-update-copy { display: grid; flex: 1; gap: 4px; } .ds-update-copy strong { font-weight: 600; } .ds-update-copy small { color: light-dark(#666666, #999999); } .ds-update-signal { flex: 0 0 8px; width: 8px; height: 8px; margin-top: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fc4f37; }

components.name: Footprint Widget
components.description: A compact raised-neutral count surface split into three equal, readable columns.
components.css: .ds-footprint { color-scheme: light dark; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); padding: 16px 0; border-radius: 16px; background: light-dark(#f5f5f5, #1c1c1c); color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .ds-footprint div { display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 0 8px; text-align: center; } .ds-footprint div + div { border-left: 1px solid light-dark(#ebebeb, #333333); } .ds-footprint strong { font-size: 1.375rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-footprint span { overflow: hidden; color: light-dark(#666666, #999999); font-size: 0.75rem; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: People Identity
components.description: A compact circular person identity used in the horizontal people pulse.
components.css: .ds-person { color-scheme: light dark; display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 72px; color: light-dark(#666666, #999999); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; text-align: center; } .ds-person > span { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 50%; background: light-dark(#f5f5f5, #1c1c1c); color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); font-weight: 600; } .ds-person small { width: 72px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Sheet Selection Row
components.description: A native-list-style context choice with a visible and accessible selected state.
components.css: .ds-selection-row { color-scheme: light dark; width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid light-dark(#ebebeb, #333333); background: light-dark(#ffffff, #000000); color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; text-align: left; } .ds-selection-row:hover { cursor: pointer; } .ds-selection-row:focus-visible { outline: auto; } .ds-selection-copy { display: grid; flex: 1; gap: 4px; } .ds-selection-copy small { color: light-dark(#666666, #999999); } .ds-selection-check { width: 24px; height: 24px; } .ds-selection-check svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; }

components.name: Your Space Dock
components.description: The fixed three-position More, voice, and chat dock with a physically centered primary voice action.
components.html: <nav class='ds-space-dock' aria-label='Your Space controls'><button aria-label='More in Your Space'>•••</button><button class='ds-space-voice' aria-label='Talk to Your Space'>⌁</button><button aria-label='Chat with Your Space'>●</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-space-dock { color-scheme: light dark; width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 56px 1fr; align-items: center; padding: 8px 24px; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); } .ds-space-dock button { width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: light-dark(#f5f5f5, #1c1c1c); color: inherit; } .ds-space-dock button:last-child { justify-self: end; } .ds-space-dock .ds-space-voice { width: 56px; height: 56px; background: #fc4f37; color: #ffffff; font-size: 1.25rem; }

narrative.overview:
Convos is a quiet personal briefing room, not an inbox dashboard. Its visual world is restrained and editorial: open space, adaptive neutral surfaces, circular identity, and a single decisive inverted surface that tells the user where attention is useful.

The briefing voice is expressive, while every control around it remains unmistakably native iOS. System components, semantic colors, Dynamic Type, and familiar sheet and list behavior keep the interface calm and trustworthy; privacy is communicated through visible provenance and deliberate boundaries rather than decorative security theater.

The authenticated shell follows the pinned topology `YS-SHELL-2026-08-18`: profile at top left, the centered space switcher, add at top right, private content between them, and a More–voice–chat dock at the bottom. The topology is durable; the content within the private space can grow as the product's evidence improves.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained, adaptive Convos neutrals with Lava reserved for unread state and the live voice entry point.
One editorial serif briefing voice inside an otherwise system-sans interface.
Circular identity, native capsules, and one softly rounded attention surface.
System glass only on persistent shell controls; native sheets and lists everywhere else.
Private-by-default content with explicit, user-initiated sharing from a conversation composer.

rules.name: The Semantic Neutral Rule
rules.body: Always use the adaptive Convos asset role for a surface or text hierarchy; do not replace it with a fixed light-appearance value.

rules.name: The Inverted Attention Rule
rules.body: Give the briefing at most one solid inverted attention surface at a time so its rarity continues to mean “start here.”

rules.name: The Signal and Voice Rule
rules.body: Lava is limited to compact unread signals and the centered voice action; green remains a compact confirmation signal. Neither becomes decorative surface paint.

rules.name: The One Serif Sentence Rule
rules.body: Reserve the system serif for the main briefing sentence; controls, rows, widgets, and sheet content remain SF system sans.

rules.name: The Pinned Shell Rule
rules.body: Preserve the profile–switcher–add top line and More–voice–chat bottom line; conversations belong behind the switcher, not in a large home-screen list.

rules.name: The Accessibility Reflow Rule
rules.body: When text reaches an accessibility size, move persistent bottom actions into the content flow rather than forcing them to compete with enlarged text.

rules.name: The Native Depth Rule
rules.body: Use system materials for persistent chrome and system sheet presentation for modal depth; content surfaces stay flat unless a semantic tonal or inverted layer carries meaning.

rules.name: The Circular Identity Rule
rules.body: People, convos, and compact shell actions stay circular; rounded rectangles are reserved for information surfaces and full-width actions.

rules.name: The Open Boundary Rule
rules.body: In PR and Dev prototype builds, private context may cross into a convo only through an explicit composer action in that destination; home voice, chat, and file actions remain private, and the composer action is not yet enabled in Production.

dos: Do compose new surfaces from Convos semantic asset colors so Light Mode and Dark Mode invert together.
Do use Dynamic Type text styles and allow the briefing, descriptions, and provenance to wrap.
Do keep identity circular and every interactive target at least `44pt`.
Do use native navigation, sheets, lists, search, toggles, menus, and SF Symbols.
Do name the source convo and express unread or urgency with words as well as color.
Do preserve the pinned `YS-SHELL-2026-08-18` topology and its private-by-default composer boundary.
donts: Don't use the serif voice for controls, row content, settings, or sheet titles.
Don't scatter inverted cards, bright accents, glass content cards, gradients, or custom shadows through the briefing.
Don't hand-build glass, modal chrome, list rows, search fields, or platform transitions.
Don't turn the home into a large conversation list or add a permanent contacts destination to this shell.
Don't infer a person's identity from message text, imply server-side synthesis, or suggest that home context was uploaded or sent automatically.
Don't keep bottom overlay actions in place when accessibility Dynamic Type makes them compete with content.
